summary.headline: D.P. Abhushan H1 FY27 revenue rose 7% to ~₹1,615 cr and EBITDA 18% to ~₹155 cr, while Q2 was hit by festive shift into Q3.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 was weak on a standalone quarterly basis because the festive calendar shifted into Q3; management pointed to H1 as the fair comparison. Total income for Q2 was about ₹761 cr, EBITDA about ₹61 cr and PAT about ₹40 cr. H1 EBITDA margin improved to 9.61% from 8.68%, and PAT margin to 6.45% from 5.82%. Management announced a preferential issue of equity and fully convertible warrants of about ₹558 cr, of which about ₹513 cr is for retail expansion and inventory. The retail network is now 14 showrooms (13 COCO, 1 FOCO), with 3 to 4 more planned by March 2027.

segments.name: Gold jewellery
segments.commentary: About 90% of inventory is gold; management cited ~8% YoY growth in gold value over the festive period. Gold jewellery fell about 9.3% during the festive window as stated on the call.

segments.name: Silver jewellery
segments.commentary: Management cited ~68% YoY value growth in silver for the festive period; silver is a small part of inventory (balance of ~5-6% is studded and remainder silver and gifts).

segments.name: Diamond / studded jewellery
segments.commentary: Management said diamond is not yet large and is an area of work; studded mix is about 5-6% of inventory.

guidance_outlook: Management expects a strong Q3 from festive and wedding demand; the wedding season is expected to be strong from December.
Historically 28-35% of annual business falls in H1 and the rest in H2, per management; expects good growth in H2 FY27 but gave no numeric revenue guidance.
Plans 3-4 additional showrooms by March 2027, including COCO stores in Jodhpur (~5,200 sq ft, by December 2026), Mandsaur (~3,500 sq ft) and Sagar (~5,800 sq ft) by end FY27.
Proposed fund raise of ~₹558 cr via equity and fully convertible warrants; ~₹513 cr for retail expansion and inventory, rest for general corporate purposes.
Breakeven for new stores in about 6-9 months (transcript reads '629 month'); inventory need ~₹60-70 cr and capex ~₹3.5-4 cr per new store.
capex_capacity: Showroom network now 14 (13 COCO + 1 FOCO). Dhar (MP) opened end-March 2026 (~3,000 sq ft); Gujarat showroom opened September 2026 (~3,200 sq ft).
First FOCO showroom in Jabalpur inaugurated 30 October 2026 (~3,750 sq ft); under FOCO the franchisee funds capex and inventory, DP Abhushan runs operations and shares revenue by category.
Fund raise of ~₹558 cr (equity and fully convertible warrants) to fund retail expansion, store inventory and general corporate purposes.
Gold procurement via customer gold exchange, gold metal loans (GML ~60-65% of total bank limit, fungible) and hedging.
demand_pricing: Management attributed the Q2 decline to festive demand shifting into Q3; cited a festive-window decline in gold jewellery of ~9.3% and a Dhanteras/Pushya Nakshatra demand decline offset in part by Q3 response.
Gold exchange programme contributes ~28-30% of business per management; the Gold Swan Plus monthly savings scheme has brought ~₹50 cr in about 5 months.
Inventory gain estimated at 18-20% of gross margin with the balance from making charges, per management's explanation (no formula; weighted average cost).
Management said 75-80% of revenue comes from wedding and festive seasons. Peer comparison: management said peers have different geographic and product mixes.
Management said the first month of Q3 showed a strong response to festive and wedding demand.

qa_highlights.question: What are the economics of the Jabalpur FOCO model and what capex, inventory and payback apply to a new COCO store?
qa_highlights.answer: Under FOCO the franchisee funds inventory and capex and revenue is shared by product category (gold, diamond, silver). For new COCO stores, management guided breakeven in about 6-9 months, inventory of ~₹60-70 cr and capex of ~₹3.5-4 cr.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the fund raise priced well below the current market price and will there be more festive updates?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the price follows the SEBI preferential-issue formula, using a 90-day reverse-working average. On updates, management said it will keep posting updates to stakeholders and the first month of Q3 showed a strong response.

qa_highlights.question: Can store-wise or geography-wise revenue be disclosed?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said store-wise revenue is not practical at 14 stores and will be considered at a geographic level; decisions are taken on overall company sales and inventory.

qa_highlights.question: How much of inventory gain reaches profit and how much revenue growth is price versus volume?
qa_highlights.answer: Management estimated inventory gain at 18-20% of profit, with the rest from making charges set on current gold rates. On growth split, management cited ~8% gold value growth and ~68% silver value growth for the festive period, and said diamond is small.

qa_highlights.question: Why did revenue decline 21% YoY in Q2 when peers reported double-digit growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the quarter should not be judged alone; H1 grew ~7%. It cited a festive shift to Q3, and said peers differ in geography and product mix (diamond share).

qa_highlights.question: What share of sales comes from gold exchange and how confident is H2 FY27 growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Exchange contributes ~28-30% of business. Management said 28-35% of annual business typically falls in H1, and it is firm on H2 growth, with no numeric FY27 revenue guidance.

risks_watch: Festive timing: Q2 revenue decline of ~21% YoY depends on Q3 and wedding season delivering; monitor Q3 FY27 numbers.
Gold price volatility affects inventory gains and the gold exchange share (~28-30% of business); the mix may change if prices stabilise.
Preferential issue priced well below the recent market price; dilution and investor reaction to the ₹558 cr fund raise.
Store expansion execution: Jodhpur, Mandsaur, Sagar and other planned openings by March 2027; new-store economics depend on ramp-up.
Limited disclosure: management declined store-wise revenue, and the diamond segment is still small.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident about H1 growth and the expansion pipeline, but defensive on the Q2 decline, attributing it to the festive shift. Answers on pricing, peer comparison and store-level disclosure were general, with few numbers. The Q&A answers on the fund-raise pricing mechanism and some business details were unclear in the transcript.
key_quotes: So half of the H1 provides a more comprehensive and representative picture of our underlying performance.
This would allow us to grow without a proportionate increase in our underlying fixed cost base.
We do not want to expand simply for the sake of adding store.

adds.what: First FOCO showroom Jabalpur (~3,750 sq ft), franchisee-funded

growth.why: H1 FY27 total income rose 7% YoY to ~₹1,615 cr and EBITDA 18%, with management expecting good H2 growth but giving no numeric revenue guidance; 3-4 new showrooms by March 2027 are backed by a ₹558 cr fund raise (~₹513 cr for retail), though only Jodhpur is under construction with a specific date.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: H1 EBITDA margin rose to 9.61% from 8.68% and PAT margin to 6.45% from 5.82%, but inventory gain (18-20% of gross margin) depends on gold price moves, and new stores take 6-9 months to break even.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Jodhpur COCO (~5,200 sq ft) under construction for December 2026, Mandsaur and Sagar planned by end FY27; 14 showrooms now, 3-4 more by March 2027 backed by a ~₹558 cr raise (~₹513 cr for retail).

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: H1 total income rose 7% YoY to ~₹1,615 cr and management expects good H2 growth; 28-35% of annual business typically falls in H1, and store additions add volume.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex of ~₹3.5-4 cr per store and ~₹60-70 cr inventory per COCO store is already funded in principle by the ₹558 cr raise, but utilisation was not disclosed, so further capex is a plan rather than a firm announcement.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: No numeric revenue or margin guidance was given; management only said H2 growth would be good and that the first month of Q3 was strong.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Q2 FY27 revenue fell about 21% YoY on festive shift and gold jewellery fell ~9.3% in the festive window; Q3 must deliver to offset this, with no numeric guidance given.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: No new product launch was discussed; diamond/studded is only ~5-6% of inventory and described as still an area of work.

rows.label: FOCO franchise model rollout (Jabalpur live)
rows.why: First FOCO showroom in Jabalpur inaugurated 30 Oct 2026 (~3,750 sq ft) with franchisee funding capex and inventory, so DP Abhushan can expand with less capital.

rows.label: ₹558 cr preferential issue of equity and warrants
rows.why: About ₹513 cr earmarked for retail expansion and inventory; priced below the recent market price under the SEBI 90-day formula, so dilution is a key watch item.

rows.label: Gold Swan Plus savings scheme and exchange programme
rows.why: Gold Swan Plus has brought ~₹50 cr in about 5 months and the gold exchange programme is ~28-30% of business, which supports steady volume.

tone.note: Management was confident on H1 growth, the Q3 festive start and the store pipeline, but defensive on the 21% Q2 decline; analysts pushed on fund-raise pricing, peer comparison and store-level disclosure, and answers were general.
